heroSubtitle: From minor dents to full collision repair — we bring your vehicle back to showroom condition with precision craftsmanship and care.
servicesSubtitle: Comprehensive auto body solutions, from collision repair to custom finishes.
svc1Desc: Full structural and cosmetic repair after accidents. We restore your vehicle's safety and appearance to factory specifications.
svc2Desc: Flawless color matching and custom paint jobs. From touch-ups to full resprays with premium materials.
svc3Desc: Paintless dent repair and traditional techniques to remove dings, dents, and hail damage without compromising your finish.
svc4Desc: Precision frame and unibody repair using computerized measuring systems to restore your vehicle's structural integrity.
svc5Desc: Professional detailing services to protect and enhance your vehicle's paint, interior, and overall appearance.
svc6Desc: We work directly with all major insurance companies to make your claims process smooth and hassle-free.
aboutP1: At Garage Arouch, we've been restoring vehicles to their former glory for over two decades. Our team of certified technicians combines old-school craftsmanship with cutting-edge technology to deliver results that exceed expectations.
aboutP2: We treat every vehicle as if it were our own — because we understand how much your car means to you. Whether it's a fender bender or major collision damage, we handle it with the same level of precision and care.
gallerySubtitle: See the transformations we deliver every day.
review1: "Garage Arouch did an incredible job on my car after a rear-end collision. You can't even tell it was ever damaged. Fast turnaround and great communication throughout."
review2: "Best body shop in the area, hands down. They matched my paint perfectly and the finish is flawless. I've been coming here for years and they never disappoint."
review3: "They handled my insurance claim from start to finish. Zero stress on my end. The repairs were done ahead of schedule and my car looks brand new."
